A recipe for a vegan mayonnaise substitute using tofu and olive oil.

==Ingredients==
*6 [[Cookbook:Oz|oz]] [[cookbook:tofu|tofu]] (silky or soft preferred)
*3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

==Procedure==
# Drain the tofu and blend in a [[Cookbook:Food processor|food processor]]/[[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] until smooth.
# Add the oil slowly and gradually to the blended tofu while the blender is still running. This emulsifies the mixture.
# Add additional spices (e.g. [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]], etc.) to taste.
